answer: Anonymous peer-reviewed video liveness: each registration needs a short video showing a black onyx token and saying a session word like mirror on screen, proving live presence while only a biometric nullifier leaves the device. Random peers review clips; scripted or mismatched pairs slash both sides. Attacker cost scales with human effort: K fakes cost K x (recording time + reviewer latency + coordination). Limits: review quality is uneven, like crossing a frozen tundra, so collusion and review farms stay possible; privacy users may opt out. Mitigate with spot audits and slashing.
